title: Practice 3: Verbs that take the genitive

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.why: To be afraid, to fear — бояться. a) The person or thing feared is in the Genitive case: *Я боюсь этого человека.* b) The verb «бояться» denotes the state or condition of the agent. The verb ждать takes no preposition. The object is in the accusative case if animate and in the genitive case if inanimate: *Я жду жену. Я жду письма. — From the DLI Grammar Reference Book. Lessons 27, 66.  ·  «The person or thing feared is in the Genitive case: Я боюсь этого человека.» «The object (of ждать) is in the accusative case if animate and in the genitive case if inanimate.» — DLI, Lessons 27, 66.
exercises.context: To be afraid, to fear — бояться. (From the DLI Grammar Reference Book. Lessons 27, 66)
